newsitem.title: DENMARK: Buoyant Danish shares seen continuing record run.
newsitem.headline: Buoyant Danish shares seen continuing record run.

text.p: The top-20 Danish KFX index closed at a new record finishing high for the fifth consecutive trading day and the 39th time this year on Monday after shares rallied on top of a cautious start, with dealers seeing more records ahead.
"The market fell in the morning but turnover bucked up by the afternoon to give us a new all-time record close. We should see more advances tomorrow," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index closed 0.49 point higher at 178.25, while the KFX August future rose 0.45 point to 179.15 with 40 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
"The market is generally positive and I think this will continue on Tuesday, helped by a good bond market," another dealer said.

A.P. Moeller's D/S 1912 hit its highest level ever, climbing 5,000 crowns to 244,000, while Den Danske Bank and Tele Danmark also helped the index up, ending the day seven and five crowns dearer at 717 and 356 crowns respectively.
